name: SOAT
summary: Self-hosted infrastructure layer for production-ready AI agents: IAM, storage, knowledge, memory, orchestration, guardrails, and traces from one Node.js server backed by PostgreSQL.

agent-runtime.note: Agents, sessions, chats, and generations with full lifecycle tracking.

orchestration.note: DAG orchestrations, workflow state machines, durable tasks, and triggers (manual, webhook, schedule).

knowledge-memory.note: Documents with per-chunk embeddings, named memories, unified semantic search, and ingestion rules for PDFs, images, and audio.

tools-integration.note: HTTP, MCP, client, and agent-to-agent tools; model routes with failover; webhooks; any LLM provider.

identity-governance.note: AWS-inspired IAM, actors, scoped API keys, guardrails, human approvals, quotas, and an append-only audit log.

observability.note: Traces of every tool call and model response, activity feed, usage/cost tracking, and an exceptions queue.

data-secrets.note: File storage over local/S3/GCS backends and encrypted secrets storage.

evaluation.note: Datasets, scorers, and scored runs; eval-gated promotion of agent versions.

channels.note: Surfaces are REST, MCP, CLI, and SDK — no built-in gateways to messaging platforms like Slack, WhatsApp, or Telegram.

code-execution.note: Tool types are HTTP, MCP, client, and agent-to-agent — no built-in sandboxed code or terminal runtime.
